cross_registry_invariants: Every industrial_frontier reference resolves to exactly one declared ID or to an explicitly allowed external Minecraft/Forge tag.
Every core technical entry references at least one source-evidence record and at least one explicit gate; the standalone extended baseline follows its own strict schema and release-gate model.
GATED_NOT_INSTALLED content has no installed_mod_ids and no invented future registry IDs.
GATED_NOT_INSTALLED extended-domain components expose no runtime item, block, entity, recipe or worldgen IDs.
Material-form conversions never permit positive material gain.
Energy converters are one-way, forbid reverse paths and remain owner-test gated when runtime limits are unknown.
THERMAL and STEAM are non-electrical carriers; their physical bridges are directional and cannot act as universal cables.
World-impact decisions never become runtime-complete on static evidence alone.

The progression graph contains each epoch 0 through 9 exactly once, only the nine forward epoch edges Pn to Pn+1, and an acyclic form→substance→process→epoch→consumer/component dependency graph covering all declared substances and critical components.

Every material process exposes typed PROCESS_CONSUMES, PROCESS_PRODUCES, PROCESS_EMITS_WASTE or PROCESS_RECYCLES records; a process without material flow has a non-material coordination exemption with a Russian reason.
Every mandatory critical component is linked one-to-one to a grind card, appears in its epoch node and exposes bootstrap and automation routes before mass demand.
Every extended-domain material, chemistry and category claim maps positionally to a typed core reference or to an explicit gated, abstract or out-of-scope concept with a reason.
Every faction role slot resolves to a compatible typed loadout archetype whose class selectors, budgets, duties and epoch bounds can only narrow the active combat passport.
validation_assumptions: A Draft 2020-12 validator loads m2_common.schema.json and resolves relative schema references from authoring/schemas.
JSON Schema validates shape; a separate cross-reference pass validates uniqueness, referential integrity, counts and graph acyclicity.
JAR-internal paths and config values are static evidence only and do not substitute for the pack owner's Minecraft test.

Construction, food, weapons, bases and faction equipment are included through m2_extended_domains as a strict non-executable baseline; future components remain GATED_NOT_INSTALLED without runtime IDs.
